NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 16 SUB-SECTIONS (2D) OF THE COAST CONSERVATION AND COASTAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT ACT No. 57 OF 1981
Proposed Sea Bed Reclamation under the Galle Port Development Project-Galle
Supplementary Environmental Impact Assessment Report

it is hereby notified that the Report of Supplementary Environmental Impact Assessment study on proposed Sea bed Reclamation under the Galle Port Development Project Galle, has been submitted by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority, No.19. Chaithya Road, Colombo 01 as required by the Section 16 (1) of the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Act No. 57 of 1981 as amended by the Act No. 64 of 1988 and No 49 of 2011 will be available for inspection by the public at the following institutions from 8.30 a.m. to 4.15 p.m. for a period of 30 days from 28.11.2024 (Except weekends and public holidays)
In addition, this report with 03 languages can be referred in the official website (www.coastal.gov.lk) of the Department of Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management.

1. Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management Department. New Secretariat Building, 4th Floor, Maligawatte, Colombo10 2. Central Environmental Authority, No. 104, ''Parisara Piyasa'' Denzil Kobbakaduwa Mawatha, Battaramulla
